title: Take the commercial property readiness assessment
summary: Use this assessment to identify readiness gaps before they become larger operational challenges.
body_markdown:
## Download the assessment


Commercial property teams are constantly balancing routine maintenance with the needs that fall outside the everyday schedule: preserving high-value surfaces, preparing for tenant activity, coordinating seasonal services, and responding when the unexpected happens.


The **Commercial Property Readiness Assessment** is a practical tool for identifying gaps, prioritizing action, and preparing your property for what’s next.


### Evaluate your current readiness across four areas:


1. **Protecting property value ‍ ‍**
2. **Supporting tenants and occupants ‍**
3. **Staying ready for what’s next ‍**
4. **Recovering faster**


‍


The assessment was informed by conversations with[Bryan Engler](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bryan-engler-a611666?utm_source=chatgpt.com) , Vice President of Operations, Great Lakes Region at ABM. In his role, Engler brings an operational perspective to the facility needs commercial property teams manage and the value of planning ahead.


> “It’s really about being proactive versus reactive.”


The assessment gives property teams a practical way to put that mindset into action.


For each readiness check, mark whether your property is ready, needs attention, or requires priority action. Then document the next step, owner, and target date so your team can turn the assessment into an action plan.


For a deeper look at the issues behind each readiness area, explore the[Beyond routine maintenance: Commercial Property Readiness Playbook .](https://www.abm.com/perspectives/%20beyond-routine-maintenance-commercial-property-readiness-playbook)
